<thought>From the spectrum, the M+2 peak (278.064 Da) has an intensity about 33 % of the monoisotopic peak, which matches the natural 35Cl/37Cl isotopic ratio (≈75 %/25 %). No other element shows such a characteristic pattern (bromine would give M+2 ≈ 100 % of M, sulfur would be ≈ 4 %). Therefore chlorine can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
